subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result classes may be replaced with stable placeholders before provider replay for cache-sensitive OpenAI-compatible models?
rationale: This is a runtime policy choice because preserving provider tool-call pairing is not enough if the placeholder hides command, file, web, or memory data the agent needs to reason about.

options.title: Narrow to status-only placeholders
options.body: Limit summarization to heartbeat/status outputs with focused tests and live DeepSeek proof, leaving data-producing tools visible.

options.title: Define a generic visibility policy
options.body: Pause this PR until tools or owners can declare cache-safe result visibility through a maintained contract.

options.title: Accept broad suppression
options.body: Allow all listed tool outputs to become placeholders, knowingly changing existing agent reasoning semantics for core tools.

recommendation.title: Narrow to status-only placeholders
recommendation.body: Limit summarization to heartbeat/status outputs with focused tests and live DeepSeek proof, leaving data-producing tools visible.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points to this contributor for the active package-level provider conversion paths that would need the rebase and policy implementation.
